text: Scope clarification from the maintainer’s 20 October instruction to recover and complete the full-material edition: the unknown output rejected in an earlier terminal run must not be replayed or reconstructed. This does not prohibit fresh independent collation of identified public-domain witnesses, including the registered AAS 1925 first printing, controlling 1962 facsimile, and historical English pages. Verify the primary pages and rights for each span; produce complete records if the checks support them. Report any new output rejection precisely without circumventing it.
